title: trust-manager
description: Installs upstream trust-manager (operator, Bundle CRD and admission webhook). The platform's Bundle lives in the internal-ca-bundle blueprint, which depends on this one.

global.title: Global values
global.description: Helm global values (injected when this chart is used as a subchart).

trust-manager.title: Upstream chart values
trust-manager.description: Passthrough to the upstream trust-manager chart. Helm requires subchart values to live under a key named after the subchart. The two values the platform derives are typed here; every other upstream value passes through as written.

namespace.title: Trust namespace
namespace.description: The only namespace trust-manager reads Bundle sources from. It must be the namespace holding the internal CA's Secret (cert-manager-issuers' internalCA.namespace, cert-manager's cluster resource namespace). Upstream default: cert-manager.

targetNamespaces.title: Target namespaces
targetNamespaces.description: Namespaces trust-manager may write Bundle targets into. When set, its ConfigMap rights are Roles in these namespaces plus the trust and release namespaces. When unset (upstream's default), a ClusterRole grants ConfigMap create, patch and delete in every namespace. List exactly internal-ca-bundle's target.namespaces.
